[LLOG.3.11.1] The engine **must** re-evaluate every time-dependent test at
each pump, under that pump's clock sample ([LLOG.11.2], [LTIM.2.4.2]). A match
the new sample refuses ends, and the `logical` facts it justified are retracted
at that pump ([LLOG.15.1]). The tick that drives this is engine-internal
([LDET.5.8]), and an author writes nothing for it.

idris.name: llog_3_11_1__alphas_three
idris.note: Three alphas, kinds 0 to 2. A fixture.

idris.name: llog_3_11_1__clock_where_retracts_timed
idris.note: A `logical` FACT JUSTIFIED BY A `now()` MATCH IS RETRACTED AT THE FIRST PUMP WHOSE SAMPLE REFUSES THE MATCH, its matched fact unchanged: the Reading at (0, 0) fires `fresh` and Fresh is emitted; an advance to 1, a Mark and a pump leave Fresh standing, the match persisting; an advance to 3, a second Mark and a pump end the match and retract Fresh -- logical/LLOG.3.11.1_clock_where_retracts_its_logical_fact's shape. 'A match the new sample refuses ends, and the `logical` facts it justified are retracted at that pump.' Executed: `[[(0, True)], [], []]`, and working memory after the second pump the Reading, Fresh and the Mark, after the third the Reading and the two Marks.

idris.name: llog_3_11_1__fresh_gate
idris.note: `now() < 2`: the `fresh` gate of the two logical fixtures. A fixture.

idris.name: llog_3_11_1__fresh_rule
idris.note: `fresh`: a Reading under `now() < 2`, emitting Fresh logical, the node loaded with the test at the sample (0, 0). A fixture.

idris.name: llog_3_11_1__relation_life
idris.note: Every kind a relation: Reading (0), Mark (1) and Fresh (2), each `logical` with one key slot. A fixture.
